environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALBv2 in us-east-1. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING override to COUNT, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK action, (3) a custom rule group 'corp-input-hygiene' with a RegexPatternSet match on query string values matching pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+(?:all\s+)?select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|extractvalue|load_file)` with action BLOCK, (4) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet in default BLOCK action. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm all four rule groups are actively evaluating. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /api/v1/health ensuring the app is responsive before receiving traffic.

config.load_balancer: ALBv2 with HTTPS listener, TLS 1.2 minimum
config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for egress only
